line: Seven of Cups: Crowley's title, planetary attribution and place on the Tree, with his account of the card.

sections.title: What Crowley says the card is
sections.line: Title and planet, as the chapter gives them (pdf 178, 205).

quotes.quote: The Seven of Cups is called Debauch.
the card is governed by Venus in Scorpio

sections.title: Its place on the Tree
sections.line: The card names Netzach (pdf 205), and the Sevens group text does the same (pdf 178). No description of the image is quoted beyond the title and attributions.

quotes.quote: This card refers to the Seven, Netzach, in the suit of Water.
These cards are attributed to Netzach.
